rules.statement: A defendant can claim rescission of the sale only for the lands where vacant possession was not given, even if multiple lands were sold in one conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think, moreover,, that we should adopt in this case the principle underlying the opinion expressed by Voet that 'if a number of things have been sold together for one (lump) price, the obligation for eviction is multiplied according to the number of the things, and as many actions are given as there are things evicted which were included in the single sale, . . . . '"
